Session span 'promptkit invoke_agent' (server kind) with gen_ai.operation.name invoke_agent, gen_ai.conversation.id, gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.agent.id
pipeline.* -> span promptkit.pipeline with promptkit.pipeline.cost and gen_ai.usage token attributes
provider.call.* -> span '{provider} chat' (client) with gen_ai.system, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.usage.*, gen_ai.response.finish_reason, promptkit.provider.cost
tool.call.* -> span execute_tool with gen_ai.tool.name, gen_ai.tool.call.id, gen_ai.tool.type; arguments only with capture on
message.created -> span event gen_ai.<role>.message on the provider span (session root if none)
middleware.* -> promptkit.middleware.{name} with name and index attributes
validation.* -> promptkit.eval.{name} with gen_ai.evaluation.name/score and promptkit.guardrail
eval.* -> instant span promptkit.eval.{evalID} with gen_ai.evaluation.name/score/explanation
workflow.transitioned / workflow.completed -> instant spans with from_state/to_state and final_state/transition_count
composition.* -> promptkit.composition and promptkit.composition.step spans with name and step_id attributes (omitted from the original page)
Original page: events are dispatched through a worker pool, not strictly in publish order, so *.completed can arrive before *.started under load
Original page: the SDK 'automatically wires an OTelEventListener' with 'full attribute detail' including message content and tool arguments by default
Spans nest under the session span (root) with the pipeline span as parent of provider/tool/middleware spans
